item_name: Rothco USMC Semper Fi Low Profile Cap
item_short_desc: Proudly display your dedication and commitment to the United States Marines with Rothco’s USMC Semper Fi Low Profile Cap. This officially licensed hat features beautifully embroidered “USMC” and “Semper Fi” lettering on the front panel, symbolizing the strength and loyalty of the Marine Corps. The iconic Globe & Anchor logo, detailed in gold, black, and white, is elegantly placed on the left side of the brim, adding a distinguished touch. This hat is officially licensed by the United States Marine Corps.
description: Proudly display your dedication and commitment to the United States Marines with Rothco’s USMC Semper Fi Low Profile Cap. This officially licensed hat features beautifully embroidered “USMC” and “Semper Fi” lettering on the front panel, symbolizing the strength and loyalty of the Marine Corps. The iconic Globe & Anchor logo, detailed in gold, black, and white, is elegantly placed on the left side of the brim, adding a distinguished touch. Made from lightweight yet durable brushed cotton twill, this baseball cap ensures comfort and longevity, making it ideal for daily wear. The buckram front panel provides essential structure to the tactical hat, while the internal sweatband keeps you dry and comfortable by preventing sweat from reaching your eyes. Designed with top ventilation holes, this rugged cap allows heat to escape, keeping you cool in any situation. The adjustable hook & loop closure strap ensures a perfect fit for most head sizes. As an officially licensed product of the United States Marine Corps, this cap is a must-have for any proud Marine or supporter. Keep your head in the game with Rothco’s collection of headwear and accessories. Designed with precision and purpose, our headgear is built to withstand the harshest conditions. Whether you’re tackling the cold in one of our Watch Caps or Balaclavas, or out on a mission in a Boonie Hat or Fatigue Cap, our diverse range of headwear provides unmatched comfort and protection for everyone from military personnel to outdoor enthusiasts.
